en.headline: LCSD launches Asian Games focal sites across 18 districts
en.dek: Public viewing hubs at designated sports centres open from 5pm today until 4 October, with a launch ceremony held at Hong Kong Park Sports Centre.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department on Saturday launched Asian Games Focal Sites at designated sports centres in all 18 districts so members of the public can watch live coverage of the 20th Asian Games and cheer for athletes from the country and Hong Kong, China.

The sites open from 5pm to 8pm on the opening day of 19 September and will operate daily from 8am to 9pm until 4 October. Details of venues and any adjustments are available on the department’s dedicated webpage.

A launching ceremony for the focal sites and the “Sports Fun For All” sports days was held at 2pm at Hong Kong Park Sports Centre. Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Raistlin Lau attended. The first sports day focused on volleyball and featured skill demonstrations in the three major ball games, sharing sessions by athletes including Sun Yue, Sze Hang-yu and Lee Ho-ching, fitness performances and interactive activities.

Hong Kong, China has sent about 580 athletes to compete in 38 sports at the Games in Aichi-Nagoya. The department encouraged residents to visit the focal sites to support the teams. Five further “Sports Fun For All” sports days will be held at different centres through December, with free admission and walk-in participation welcomed.

zh.headline: 康文署全港18區啟動活力亞運觀賞站
zh.dek: 指定體育館今日下午5時起開放至10月4日，香港公園體育館舉行啟動禮及全民動起來運動日。
body: 康樂及文化事務署今日（9月19日）於全港18區指定體育館設立「活力亞運觀賞站」，播放第二十屆亞洲運動會賽事，讓市民到場觀看並為國家隊及中國香港運動員打氣。
觀賞站於亞運開幕當日下午5時至晚上8時開放，其後每日上午8時至晚上9時，直至10月4日為止。場地詳情及任何調整可於署方專題網頁查閱。
署方下午2時於香港公園體育館舉行「全民動起來暨活力亞運觀賞站啟動禮」，文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震出席。首場運動日以排球為主題，包括三大球技術示範、體壇名將孫玥、施幸余及李皓晴分享經驗，以及健身操表演及互動遊戲等活動。
中國香港代表團派出約580名運動員出戰38個項目。康文署鼓勵市民到觀賞站支持運動員。另外五場「全民動起來」運動日將於9月至12月在不同體育館舉行，免費入場，歡迎即場參與。
